svg.title: The GP3 pipeline
svg.desc: A block diagram of the GP3 pipeline in two rows. Top row, left to right: a gray box Factory state; a white box Selection with tag 1; a white box Generator with tag 2; a white box Planner with tag 3, which also takes an arrow from a gray box Domain on its right. An arrow goes down from the planner to a gray box Plan. Bottom row, right to left: Plan, a white box Plan-to-BT with tag 4, a white box Behavior tree, and a white box Factory. An arrow goes up from the factory to Factory state, closing the loop.
